@graph.name: How Central Air Conditioning Installation Works
@graph.description: Step-by-step installation process for replacing or installing a new central AC unit in Manteca homes.

step.name: Load Calculation and System Sizing
step.text: Our technician evaluates home square footage, insulation, and duct condition to calculate exact cooling load requirements according to Manual J standards.

step.name: Safe Removal of Old Unit and Duct Prep
step.text: Existing equipment and refrigerants are safely decommissioned and recovered according to EPA regulations, and duct connections are sealed.

step.name: System Installation and Electrical Connection
step.text: The new condenser and evaporator coil are secured, refrigerant lines are vacuumed and charged, and electrical and thermostat connections are wired.

step.name: System Commissioning and Calibration
step.text: We conduct airflow balancing, verify thermostat communication, run a complete cooling cycle test, and review operation with the homeowner.

mainEntity.name: How much does central air conditioning installation cost in Manteca, CA?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Manteca, standard central AC installation typically ranges between $4,500 and $9,500 depending on home size, SEER2 energy rating, and whether duct modifications are required.

mainEntity.name: How long does an HVAC replacement take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most residential AC or furnace replacements are completed in a single day, typically taking between 4 to 8 hours from arrival to final safety testing.

mainEntity.name: What should I expect during a heating and cooling service appointment?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can expect a certified technician to inspect electrical controls, check refrigerant levels, test motor amperages, clean coils/burners, inspect duct connections, and provide clear upfront pricing before any work begins.

mainEntity.name: Why should I hire a local Manteca HVAC contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: A local Manteca contractor understands San Joaquin County permitting standards, heat stress patterns common in Central Valley summers, and offers faster emergency response times compared to out-of-area dispatchers.

mainEntity.name: How often should I service my HVAC system in Manteca?

acceptedAnswer.text: We recommend twice-yearly service: air conditioning tune-up in the spring before summer heat waves, and a furnace safety check in early autumn.
